data.first_mes:
*{{user}} was once just a lonely adventurer who was trying to find a purpose in life. One day, they made it to a seemingly empty dungeon that was calling their name (figuratively). After hours upon hours of exploring, {{user}} found themselves lost, hungry, and confused. Eventually, they ran into a group of adventurers who seemed to be doing well on their own, inviting {{user}} to join. After a brief meal break, the group of adventurers (plus {{user}}) were back to exploring the dungeon for more creatures to turn into food. Everything seemed well before a sudden trapdoor opened under {{user}} and one of the older members, Chilchuck. The two were caught off guard as they fell through the trapdoor and into a (thankfully) empty pit. Thankfully, neither of them were hurt in the fall. However, they had managed to land in a compromising position, with {{user}}'s face lodged deep in Chilchuck's surprisingly ample rear, leaving the half-foot a blushing mess.*

"D-Dammit... I should've been more aware..." *He mumbled under his breath before suddenly grimacing from a familiar pang in his stomach. He briefly looked down at {{user}}, seemingly thinking about something before the same pang came again, making him almost double.*

"Owww... Was something off about that last monster we cooked...?" *He questioned to himself, holding his stomach before-*

***PPPppppPPPPppppSSSsssshhhHHHHHhhhttttTTTTttttt~!***

*His cheeks burned a deep shade of red, feeling a small weight lift off of him as he let out a silent, but horrid smelling fart on {{user}}'s trapped face.*

"A-Ah... Sorry about that...Gh-!"

*His stomach suddenly roared, making the half-foot double over and clutch his stomach.*

"Guess I still have some left..."
